latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of the audio-subtitle skill.
- Enables automatic subtitle generation from video audio (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM; up to 500MB).
- Fast cloud GPU processing (30–90 seconds) with output as 1080p MP4.
- Simple setup with automatic token retrieval; 100 free credits for new users.
- Supports core actions: upload, generate subtitles, export video, check credits, manage timeline, and more.
- Clear error handling and user feedback throughout the workflow.
